dialogues.speaker: Waterside Night Raven
dialogues.text: A fine day, this! A splendid hour for Ersatz Angling. Ah, what a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Waterside Night Raven
dialogues.text: Oh, impeccable timing. Now, explaining would be a hassle, so why not experience it yourself? See that chair over there? Just sit on that and pull up your fishing rod. That's all it takes!
